 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results Live Updates: TDP wins 5,169 MPTC seats; YSRCP bags 1,140, Jana Sena 667 and BJP 135 
 Save Share Comments AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results Live Updates: TDP wins 5,169 MPTC seats; YSRCP bags 1,140, Jana Sena 667 and BJP 135
 THE TIMES OF INDIA | Nov 07, 2026, 20:54:43 IST SUMMARY Andhra Pradesh is counting votes polled in the Mandal Parishad Territorial Constituency (MPTC) and Zilla Parishad Territorial Constituency (ZPTC) elections on Saturday, with elaborate security arrangements in place across the state. 
 The counting began at 8 am at 365 centres, where the State Election Commission (SEC) has set up 9,062 counting tables. Around 11,002 counting supervisors and 28,692 counting assistants and other staff have been deployed for the exercise. Nearly 19,885 police personnel are providing three-layer security, while CCTV cameras, drones and body-worn cameras are being used to monitor sensitive areas. 
 The counting process began with postal ballots, followed by ballot papers collected from polling stations. Pink ballot papers for MPTC elections and white ballot papers for ZPTC elections are being separated, bundled in groups of 25 and mixed in separate drums before counting. 
 Polling for 577 ZPTCs and 7,707 MPTCs was held on Thursday, recording a final turnout of 70.72%, 9.81 percentage points higher than in the 2021 elections. Elections in five mandals were held on Friday due to Cyclone Murasu, while repolling was conducted at seven polling stations following reports of booth capturing and ballot box damage. 
 Meanwhile, the YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) has accused the TDP-led coalition government of electoral malpractice, intimidation of opposition workers and misuse of official machinery. Former minister Kakani Govardhan Reddy demanded fresh polling in areas where alleged irregularities took place and action against officials accused of failing to ensure free and fair elections. Live Events 
 20:50 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: TDP accuses YSRCP MLC Lella Appi Reddy of ballot box snatching in Vengalayapalem (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN)
TDP leaders, led by MLC Varla Ramaiah, lodged a complaint with the State Election Commission alleging that YSRCP MLC Lella Appi Reddy and his followers assaulted a polling officer and forcibly took a ballot box containing votes onto the street in Vengalayapalem in Guntur district's Prathipadu constituency. The delegation submitted photographic evidence and sought action against Appi Reddy. TDP also claimed to have submitted 82 complaints across 47 constituencies over alleged election violations. 20:36 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: YSRCP alleges foul play in KVB Puram ZPTC counting, claims candidate won by 190 votes (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN)
 YSRCP alleged foul play in the counting of votes for the KVB Puram ZPTC seat in Tirupati district, claiming that its candidate Bathala Sujatha had won by a margin of 190 votes by 6pm. The party alleged that TDP sought a recount with the involvement of its constituency in-charge Shankar Reddy, delaying the official declaration of the result. YSRCP constituency in-charge Nukathoti Rajesh criticised the conduct of polling officials.
 20:01 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: TDP leads in 187 MPTC and 20 ZPTC segments in Tirupati district (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN)
 In Tirupati district, TDP is leading in 187 of the 302 contested MPTC segments, compared with YSRCP in 75. Jana Sena is ahead in 13 segments, BJP in eight and others in 10. Six segments are tied, while counting has not started in three.
 For the 31 contested ZPTC segments, TDP is leading in 20, YSRCP in six, BJP in two, Jana Sena in one and others in two. TDP is ahead of YSRCP in 119 more MPTC segments and 15 more ZPTC segments in the segment-wise comparison where both parties are contesting and counting has started.
 19:27 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: TDP wins 5,169 of 7,291 declared MPTC seats; YSRCP bags 1,140 (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN)
 TDP has won 5,169 of the 7,291 MPTC seats for which results have been declared in Andhra Pradesh. YSRCP has secured 1,140 seats, followed by Jana Sena with 667 and BJP with 135. Others have won 180 seats. No leads remain.
 Updated tally:
- TDP: 5,169
- YSRCP: 1,140
- Jana Sena: 667
- BJP: 135
- Others: 180
 19:18 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: YSRCP's Chevireddy Harshit Reddy leads Tirupati Rural ZPTC seat by 1,321 votes (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN)
 YSRCP candidate Chevireddy Harshit Reddy continues to lead in the Tirupati Rural ZPTC seat in Chandragiri constituency. After the fourth round of counting, he has secured 2,103 votes against TDP's 1,830, taking his overall lead to 1,321 votes.
 19:00 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: TDP leads in 8 ZPTC seats in Tirupati, wins 4 unopposed; BJP bags 1 (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN)
 In Tirupati district, TDP is leading in eight ZPTC seats, while it has won four unopposed. The party has also won the Thottambedu and Venkatagiri seats. BJP has won Renigunta and is leading in Sullurpeta, while Jana Sena is ahead in Koduru. YSRCP is leading in Pellakuru and Tirupati Rural. Results are awaited in the remaining constituencies.

YSRCP candidate Kamireddy Satyanarayana Reddy has won the Pellakuru ZPTC seat in Tirupati district while contesting from jail. He had earlier been reported as leading in the constituency. YSRCP MP M Gurumoorthy hailed the victory as a people's verdict against what he termed the TDP's vindictive politics. 18:09 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: TDP wins 4,368 of 5,970 declared MPTC seats; YSRCP bags 829 (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN)
 TDP has won 4,368 of the 5,970 MPTC seats for which results have been declared in Andhra Pradesh. YSRCP has secured 829 seats, followed by Jana Sena with 506 and BJP with 119. Others have won 148 seats.
 18:02 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: YS Jagan condemns arrest of YSRCP MLC, alleges ballot boxes were unloaded midway in Guntur YSRCP president YS Jagan Mohan Reddy condemned the arrest of party MLC and general secretary Lella Appi Reddy, alleging that ballot boxes polled in Vengalayapalem village of Guntur Rural mandal were unloaded at Nallapadu while being transported to Nagarjuna University. He questioned why the boxes were unloaded and alleged that police used force against party workers and residents protesting over the incident. 16:17 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: YSRCP wins Vempalle ZPTC seat by 19,203 votes (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN)
 YSRCP candidate Bathala Venkata Sivamma won the Vempalle ZPTC seat in YSR Kadapa district’s Pulivendula constituency by a majority of 19,203 votes.
 14:45 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: YSRCP wins 4 MPTC seats, TDP bags 3 in Venkatagiri mandal (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN)
 In Andhra Pradesh's Zilla Parishad elections, the YSRCP won four MPTC seats in Venkatagiri mandal of Tirupati district, while the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) secured three seats.
 The YSRCP candidates won from Jangalapalli, Partavolu, Petluru and Vallivedu, while TDP candidates emerged victorious in Papamambapuram, Somasaniguta and Palem Kota. The Jana Sena Party (JSP) failed to win any seats in the mandal. 
 14:12 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: YSRCP alleges counting irregularities in Illathuru MPTC seat, RK Roja stages protest (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN)
 Former minister and YSRCP leader RK Roja, along with party cadres, staged a sit-in protest outside the counting centre at Nagari Degree College in Andhra Pradesh.
The YSRCP alleged that its candidate had won the Illathuru MPTC seat in Vijayapuram mandal, but election officials declared the TDP candidate the winner. The party demanded a recount and urged officials to ensure that the process was conducted transparently.
The YSRCP also claimed that police forcibly evicted its MPP candidate from the counting centre. Protesting against the alleged irregularities, Roja and party workers staged a sit-in outside the venue, demanding a fair recount and justice.
 13:58 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: TDP's Bharathi wins Pulivendula ZPTC seat in Kadapa by 1,463 votes (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN)
 The Telugu Desam Party (TDP) has won the Pulivendula Zilla Parishad Territorial Constituency (ZPTC) seat in YSR Kadapa district, with its candidate Bharathi securing victory by a margin of 1,463 votes.
The victory adds to the TDP-led alliance's gains in the Andhra Pradesh local body elections, with the ruling alliance also making its presence felt in the Pulivendula parishad polls.
 13:03 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: YSRCP wins Jangalapalli MPTC seat in Venkatagiri by 263 votes YSRCP candidate has won the Jangalapalli MPTC seat in Venkatagiri mandal by a margin of 263 votes, securing 787 votes against 524 polled by the TDP candidate.
The YSRCP candidate secured 57.07% of the total votes, while the TDP candidate received 38%. Of the 1,379 votes polled, 16 were recorded as NOTA and 52 were declared invalid. The total valid votes, including NOTA, stood at 1,327. 13:00 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: TDP leads in 102 ZPTC seats and wins 77; Jana Sena secures 3, BJP 4 and YSRCP 1 (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN)
 In the Andhra Pradesh ZPTC elections, the TDP is leading in 102 of the 216 seats for which trends are available and has won 77 seats. Jana Sena is leading in 18 seats and has won three, while the BJP is ahead in two seats and has won four. The YSRCP is leading in nine seats and has secured one victory. No leads or wins have been recorded by other parties so far. Results and trends are available for 216 of the total 659 ZPTC seats.
 12:59 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: TDP sweeps 1,957 out of 2,294 MPTC seats; YSRCP wins 125, Jana Sena 113 and BJP 59 (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN) 
 In the Andhra Pradesh MPTC elections, the TDP has won 1,957 of the 2,294 seats for which results have been declared. The YSRCP has secured 125 seats, while Jana Sena has won 113 and the BJP 59. Other parties and independent candidates have bagged 40 seats. No seats are currently showing a lead, with results declared for 2,294 of the total 9,829 MPTC seats.
 12:46 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results Live Updates: Counting of votes underway for MPTC, ZPTC elections across Andhra Pradesh; three-tier security in place (Reported by ANI)
 The counting process for the Mandal Parishad Territorial Constituency (MPTC) and Zilla Parishad Territorial Constituency (ZPTC) rural local body elections across Andhra Pradesh is currently underway peacefully. Authorities have implemented robust security measures to ensure a smooth procedure.
 Speaking on the security arrangements, Visakhapatnam Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Pradeepthi said that a three-level security layer has been ensured, along with proper bandobast, to guarantee a completely peaceful counting process.
 "As of now, the counting process is going on very peacefully. We have ensured a three-level security layer and ensured proper bandobast to provide a proper, peaceful bandobast, peaceful counting inside," she said.
 Providing details on the current operations, the ACP noted that counting is specifically taking place for the Pendurthi mandal, which involves 8 MPTCs and 1 ZPTC. 
 She noted that the counting is being conducted inside the designated counting hall. Returning Officers (ROs) and Assistant Returning Officers (AROs) are present at the location.
 Officials confirmed that all necessary personnel are on-site alongside the ACP, and the DCP and CP are scheduled to visit the counting centre shortly. 
 "As of now, the counting process is going on peacefully. As of now, regarding only Pendurthi mandal, Pendurthi mandal counting is going on. For that, 8 MPTCs and one ZPTC. So the counting is going on inside the counting hall, and the Returning Officer and RDO are also there. Everyone is present along with the DCP, and CP will also be visiting in a while," she said.
 Meanwhile, NTR District Collector G Lakshmisha said that the counting process for the MPTC and ZPTC elections is being conducted transparently and in a peaceful atmosphere. He is monitoring the counting process from the Command Control Room at the Vijayawada Collectorate.
 Speaking on the occasion, he said that the postal ballot counting process was completed by 10 AM. The first round of counting has begun, he said. 
 He stated that counting centres have been set up at nine places across the district for 16 ZPTC and 276 MPTC seats, with all necessary basic facilities provided. 
He revealed that counting halls, tables, barricades, entry and exit routes, CCTV cameras, drinking water, electricity, lighting, alternative power supply and security arrangements have been completed at the counting centres. He said that the Returning Officers will officially announce the election results after thoroughly checking and verifying the round-wise details.
 He said that tight police security arrangements have been made to ensure that there is no disturbance to law and order in and around the counting centres. He said measures like allowing only authorised persons with ID cards into the counting centres, strictly implementing the rules laid down by the State Election Commission, and continuously monitoring the counting process are being taken.
 Collector Lakshmisha said that counting for the segments of A. Konduru, Vissannapeta, Tiruvuru and Gampalagudem mandals will take place at the Sri Vahini Institute of Science and Technology College centre in Tiruvuru.
 For the Vijayawada Rural mandal, counting will take place at the Vijayawada Sub-Collector Office, Old Montessori College. For G. Konduru, counting will take place at Lakireddy Hanimireddy Government Degree College in Kuntamukkala.
 Similarly, for Mylavaram and Reddigudem mandals, counting will take place at Lakireddy Hanimireddy Indoor Stadium in Mylavaram; for Ibrahimpatnam, at Kondapalli ZP Girls High School; and for Jaggayyapeta, Penuganchiprolu and Vatsavai mandals, at SGS College Centre in Jaggayyapeta.
 For Nandigama mandal, counting will take place at Nandigama ZP High School; for Chandralapadu, at Nandigama KVR Degree College; and for Kanchikacherla and Veerullapadu mandals, at the counting centre set up in Kanchikacherla Market Yard, Collector Lakshmisha said.
 Counting of votes is underway in Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam, Alluri Sitharama Raju, Anakapalli, and Parvathipuram Manyam. In the Godavari region, counting is taking place in Kakinada, East Godavari; Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema, Eluru, West Godavari, Polavaram, Krishna, NTR, Guntur, Bapatla, Palnadu, Prakasam, Markapuram, SPSR Nellore, Tirupati, Chittoor, Annamayya, YSR Kadapa, Kurnool, Nandyal, Anantapur, and Sri Sathya Sai districts.
 Polling for the ZPTC and MPTC elections began at 7 PM on Thursday and continued until 5 PM.

 10:07 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results Live Updates: TDP dominates early ZPTC results, wins 72 of 106 declared seats in Andhra Pradesh (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan)
 The Telugu Desam Party (TDP) is leading the Andhra Pradesh Zilla Parishad Territorial Constituency (ZPTC) election results, having won 72 of the 106 seats for which results have been declared and leading in another 21 seats.
 Jana Sena has won three seats and is leading in five, while the BJP has secured three seats. The YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) has won one seat and is leading in another. Other parties and independent candidates have not secured any seats or leads so far.
 The results have been reported for 106 of the total 659 ZPTC seats, with counting underway across the state.
 10:01 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results Live: Vote counting for MPTC, ZPTC elections begins peacefully in NTR District The counting of votes for the Mandal Parishad Territorial Constituency (MPTC) and Zilla Parishad Territorial Constituency (ZPTC) rural local body elections commenced peacefully across NTR district on Saturday morning.
 The counting centres have been set up at nine places across the district for 16 ZPTC and 276 MPTC seats, with all necessary basic facilities provided.
 For smooth conduct of the counting process, 18 counting halls and 281 counting tables have been arranged. Around 1,500 counting supervisors, counting assistants and other supporting staff have been deployed.
 Three-tier heavy police security under the supervision of 7 DSPs, 37 CIs and 64 SIs has been arranged and deployed at the counting centres. 
 At the counting centres, CCTV cameras, drinking water, electricity, lighting, alternative power supply and security arrangements have been made. 
 09:47 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results Live Update: Independent candidate leads in Krishnagiri ZPTC postal ballot count (Reported by Sandeep Raghavan/TNN) 
 Postal ballot counting for the Krishnagiri ZPTC constituency in Kurnool district has recorded a lead for independent candidate Sriramulu, who secured nine of the 13 votes counted. YSRCP candidate Madhava Rao received three votes, while another independent candidate, Valmiki Peddaiah, polled one vote. Venkata Hari Erravadu received no votes.

CCTV cameras have been installed at all centres, while drones and body-worn cameras will be used to monitor sensitive areas and ensure orderly counting. 09:37 (IST) Nov 07 AP MPTC, ZPTC Election Results: Counting begins at 8 am across 365 centres Andhra Pradesh began counting votes for MPTC and ZPTC elections at 8 am on Saturday. The State Election Commission set up 9,062 counting tables and deployed 11,002 supervisors and 28,692 counting assistants and other staff across the state. Andhra Pradesh is counting votes for the Mandal Parishad Territorial Constituency (MPTC) and Zilla Parishad Territorial Constituency (ZPTC) elections on Saturday, with elaborate arrangements in place across 365 counting centres. The counting began at 8 am, with the State Election Commission (SEC) deploying 11,002 counting supervisors and 28,692 counting assistants and other staff. A total of 9,062 counting tables have been arranged for the exercise.
Nearly 19,885 police personnel have been deployed to provide three-layer security at the counting centres. CCTV cameras have been installed at all centres, while drones and body-worn cameras will be used to monitor sensitive areas. The counting process began with postal ballots, followed by ballot papers collected from polling stations. Pink-coloured ballot papers for MPTC elections and white-coloured papers for ZPTC elections are being separated, bundled in groups of 25 and mixed in separate drums before counting.
Polling for 577 ZPTCs and 7,707 MPTCs was held on Thursday, recording a final turnout of 70.72%, which was 9.81 percentage points higher than the turnout in the 2021 elections. Candidates for 77 ZPTCs and 2,051 MPTCs were elected unanimously as they were the only candidates remaining in the fray after the withdrawal deadline.
Due to Cyclone Murasu, polling in Gopalapuram mandal in East Godavari district and four mandals in Eluru district was conducted on Friday. Repolling was also held at seven polling stations following reports of booth capturing and damage to ballot boxes.
Meanwhile, the YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) accused the TDP-led coalition government of conducting the elections in an undemocratic manner, alleging misuse of official machinery, intimidation of opposition workers and electoral malpractice. Former minister Kakani Govardhan Reddy claimed that YSRCP workers and polling agents were detained or prevented from participating in the electoral process, while ruling coalition members were allowed to move freely. He also alleged that police failed to act on complaints of rigging and attacks on party workers.
Reddy demanded fresh polling in areas where alleged irregularities occurred, action against officials accused of facilitating malpractice and accountability from the authorities. The SEC's counting exercise comes amid these allegations by the opposition party.
